desc: baseline model + one feature lit_prior_pct: HGB (same hgb settings) pretrained once on cone_lit_benchmark_v1.csv rows with char_residue_pct in [0, 100], features heat_flux_kWm2, fr_total_wtpct, filler_total_wtpct, is_EP, is_fibre_composite, is_P_FR (components match phosph|APP|DOPO|RDP|TEDAP|phosphate|phosphonate). Excluded: DOIs with a component matching T58|ERYSIS|GE-60|sorbitol polyglycidyl|pentaerythritol polyglycidyl|glycerol polyglycidyl|GFTE|DETDA, plus DOIs containing polym11020303, ppch.19468, polym8090322, ma10050467 (Toldy group / Pomazi sources). Mapping for reconstruction rows: fr_total = fr1_ratio_pct + fr2_ratio_pct (NaN -> 0), filler = fibre_wtpct, is_EP 1, is_fibre_composite = fibre_wtpct > 0, is_P_FR = P_pct > 0.

full_fit.protocol: training fit (same protocol as BME: full-dataset fit)
